name: COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method for novel view synthesis and camera pose estimation from unposed video sequences without Structure-from-Motion (SfM) preprocessing. It leverages temporal continuity and explicit point cloud representation to progressively grow a global 3D Gaussian set.
summary: COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting is a novel view synthesis method that estimates camera poses and builds 3D scenes from unposed video without Structure-from-Motion preprocessing.
